contenders.handicapper_notes: Blueblood Godolphin filly by Too Darn Hot out of VRC Oaks winner Zydeco. Well-bred Shamus Award filly who caught the eye on debut at Bendigo over 1300m in heavy conditions, making late headway from the tail to finish 4th. The step up to 1500m on the expansive Hillside track is ideal for her closing profile and stamina pedigree.
